segment.kind: isolated frozen experimental interval; reference collection begins later and does not reconstruct a contemporaneous early census

selection.universe: all rows from independent current PumpSwap DEX pages1–3 at each pass; retain rejected rows and duplicate positions
selection.eligibility: canonicalSOL PDA address consistency and indexed creation-age5min–2h at actual receipt; hint only, not onchain support
selection.ranking: union of independently indexed provisional eligible leads from both passes, descending maximum reported5minute volume, then maximum24hour volume, then pool lexical; never POE-selected or ranked by later OHLC outcome
selection.feesOrExecution: not established by listing or OHLC

limitations: Listing snapshots reflect actual retrieval times, not market universe at segment start.
Current rank and three-page sampling create coverage, survival, pagination and selection bias.
Canonical PDA and indexed time are scheduling leads, not confirmed migration/current support proof.
Reported price, volume, transaction counts and liquidity are index claims; no trader identities, net buying or actual50USD execution inferred.
API public access has no additional subscription/key cost; infrastructure/transfer allocations remain unverified.
network: HTTPS api.geckoterminal.com only; no SolanaRPC, credentials, wallets or pilot writes
